slot.brief: A thermometer reads a temperature on one scale; convert it to another scale and pick the correct numerical value.

stem: A thermometer immersed in a water bath records a temperature of $45^\circ\text{C}$. What is the corresponding reading on the Fahrenheit scale?
working:
The relationship between the Celsius scale ($T_C$) and the Fahrenheit scale ($T_F$) is given by:
$$T_F = \dfrac{9}{5}T_C + 32$$

Substitute $T_C = 45^\circ\text{C}$:
$$T_F = \left(\dfrac{9}{5} \times 45\right) + 32 = 81 + 32 = 113^\circ\text{F}$$

Independent check: F = (9/5)C + 32 = (9/5)(45) + 32 = 81 + 32 = 113°F.
